name: Lumora AI
summary: Pure black, engineered AI-automation agency site built on a visible 1px column grid, with halftone orange light, mono labels and terminal-style UI panels.

fonts.pairing: light-regular grotesk headlines with no tracking, humanist Cabin body, JetBrains Mono uppercase for tags and buttons

signature: visible page frame: 1px vertical rails and full-width separator bands with diagonal hatch fills between every section
orange and white halftone dot light (liquid-gradient shader through a dot mask) behind a monospace workflow panel in the hero
dot-matrix pixel arrow inside square-cornered white buttons
sticky left tab list that switches the service panels as you scroll
imagery: almost no photography; terminal-like UI panels (workflow steps, struck-through task lists, segmented progress bars, app icon grids); one black and white founder portrait
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 30px outer padding with 1px rails, content inside a framed column, 60px hatched separator bands, 2px radii everywhere
